name: Anonymise Uploads
description: Replaces the names of files you upload with random ones.

name: Bookmarks
description: Bookmark messages and jump back to them from any chat.

name: Calculator
description: Adds /calc: type an expression and send it with its result.

name: Character Counter
description: Shows how many characters you've typed out of Telegram's 4096 limit.

name: Chat Colorizer
description: Gives every person a consistent name colour, with your own overrides per contact.

name: Chat Export
description: Export the loaded messages of a chat as text, Markdown or JSON.

name: Chat Statistics
description: Statistics for the loaded part of a chat: messages per person, busiest hours, top words.

name: Client Colors
description: Pick accent and background colours for the whole client.

name: Copy Enhancer
description: Extra copy options: as a quote, with sender and time, or as Markdown.

name: Link Collection
description: Lists every link shared in the loaded part of a chat.

name: Link Preview Control
description: Choose whether links you send get a preview card. Wrap a link in <…> to skip its preview.

name: Link Scrubber
description: Removes tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, si, …) from links you send.

name: Local Pins
description: Pin chats to the top of your list on this device only, beyond Telegram's own pin limit.

name: Message Highlight
description: Highlights messages containing your keywords, each with its own colour.

name: Message History
description: Keeps deleted messages visible (struck through) and shows edit history. Stored only in memory on this device.

name: Message Templates
description: Reusable message templates with {date}, {time}, {chat} and {cursor} placeholders.

name: Name Display
description: Show @usernames next to (or instead of) display names.

name: Precise Timestamps
description: Choose how message times are shown, down to the second.

name: Privacy Mode
description: Blur chat previews, names, avatars or messages on your screen, plus a privacy screen when the window loses focus. Ctrl+Shift+H toggles a full blur.

name: Quick Commands
description: Adds /shrug, /tableflip, /lenny and your own text-snippet commands.

name: Quick Notes
description: A private notes panel for each chat, kept only on this device.

name: Read All
description: Adds a button that marks every chat as read.

name: Secret Guard
description: Blocks messages that look like passwords, API keys, private keys or card numbers. Start a message with “!! ” to send anyway.

name: Send Latency
description: Shows how long Telegram took to accept each message you send.

name: Silent Send
description: Adds a bell toggle and /silent to send messages without a notification sound.

name: Silent Typing
description: Don't show others that you're typing.

name: Text Replace
description: Automatically replaces text in messages you send using your own rules.

name: Unindent
description: Trims shared indentation from code blocks you paste and send.

name: View Raw
description: Adds “View raw” to the message menu, showing the message exactly as the client sees it.
